+"""RoboLab limited-mode controller for moving the spoon from the wooden bowl to the mug.
+
+Run one stage at a time in the live episode, in order:
+  python /app/output/gen.py approach
+  python /app/output/gen.py grasp
+  python /app/output/gen.py lift
+  python /app/output/gen.py transfer
+  python /app/output/gen.py release
+
+The camera-derived target estimates are in the env-local robot frame. No object
+state or success predicate is used.
+"""
+import json
+import os
+import sys
+import numpy as np
+sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
+from rcb_client import Robot, EpisodeOver
+
+OUT = "/app/output"
+RUNS = "/app/runs"
+os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)
+os.makedirs(RUNS, exist_ok=True)
+
+# Reset TCP orientation is a straight-down approach. A 90 degree world yaw
+# puts the Robotiq jaw closing axis across the spoon handle.
+Q_DOWN_ACROSS_HANDLE = np.array([0.0, -1.0, 0.0, 0.0], dtype=np.float32)
+
+# Handle segment exposed beyond the bowl rim, estimated from the calibrated
+# egocentric RGB-D image (around pixel 690, 325; z-depth backprojection).
+HANDLE = np.array([0.722, 0.310, 0.083], dtype=np.float32)
+# Center of the ceramic mug opening, estimated from the yellow rim in RGB-D.
+MUG = np.array([0.505, 0.420, 0.087], dtype=np.float32)
+
+def pose(xyz, grip=0.0):
+    return np.r_[np.asarray(xyz, dtype=np.float32), Q_DOWN_ACROSS_HANDLE, np.float32(grip)]
+
+def run(name, targets, note):
+    robot = Robot()
+    result = robot.submit("ee_pose", np.asarray(targets, dtype=np.float32), video="both", video_fps=8, note=note)
+    dest = os.path.join(RUNS, name)
+    result.save(dest)
+    print(json.dumps({"stage": name, "done": result.done, "reason": result.meta.get("reason"),
+                      "plan": result.meta.get("plan"), "clipped": result.meta.get("clipped"),
+                      "control_steps_chunk": result.meta.get("control_steps_chunk"),
+                      "time_left_s": result.meta.get("time_left_s"), "saved": dest}, indent=2))
+    if result.done:
+        return
+    if result.last:
+        # Keep a compact latest visual check alongside the full run recording.
+        from PIL import Image
+        for cam, im in result.last.items():
+            Image.fromarray(im).save(os.path.join(OUT, f"{name}_{cam}.png"))
+
+def main(stage):
+    if stage == "approach":
+        # Travel above the table clutter, then pause with the tips 7 cm above
+        # the estimated handle point for a wrist-camera check.
+        run(stage, [pose([0.64, 0.28, 0.29]), pose([0.69, 0.30, 0.17])],
+            "Move over the spoon handle; keep gripper open for visual alignment")
+    elif stage == "grasp":
+        # Close vertically around the exposed metal handle. First settle at
+        # the camera-estimated top surface, then close without moving the arm.
+        run(stage, [pose([0.722, 0.310, 0.083], 0.0), pose([0.722, 0.310, 0.083], 1.0)],
+            "Lower to the exposed spoon handle and close the Robotiq gripper")
+    elif stage == "lift":
+        run(stage, [pose([0.70, 0.30, 0.30], 1.0)],
+            "Lift the grasped spoon clear of the wooden bowl and table objects")
+    elif stage == "transfer":
+        # Spoon center lies slightly toward the bowl end from the handle grasp;
+        # aim the held handle just behind the center of the mug opening.
+        run(stage, [pose([0.505, 0.420, 0.27], 1.0), pose([0.505, 0.420, 0.20], 1.0)],
+            "Carry the spoon above the mug and center it over the opening")
+    elif stage == "release":
+        run(stage, [pose([0.505, 0.420, 0.20], 0.0)],
+            "Open the gripper over the mug to release the spoon inside")
+    elif stage == "observe":

+        obs = robot.get_obs(depth=True)
+        from PIL import Image
+        for cam, im in obs.last.items():
+            Image.fromarray(im).save(os.path.join(OUT, f"latest_{cam}.png"))
